description:
After being electrocuted while entering a VR game capsule, the protagonist wakes up inside the game “Graduate from the Academy by Luck” as “OK NO DIE,” the daughter of the main villain. Although others see her as a pitiable child raised by an evil organization, she’s secretly a hardcore gamer thrilled with stat-min-maxing. She enjoys collecting stat shards, strategizing, and training in real-combat scenarios, all while everyone else misreads her as suffering. With comedy stemming from this misperception, the story follows her lively academy life, dedicated to maximizing her stats and enjoying every moment even as she navigates a world that sees her as a tragic figure.
